authorization.preparation_instruction: Prepare the two-seed execution package: seeds 7 and 2027, width 128, learning rate 0.0003; sequential, maximum 2 hours each. Obtain exact run/spend approval.
authorization.approval_binding: SHA-256 of this exact JSON file, including all referenced file hashes
authorization.scope_if_approved: two unique Jobs, one attempt per listed seed; bounded signed-context delivery, independent readback and reports; cancellation only to enforce these bounds

sequence_gate: seed-7 must be provider COMPLETED and independently verified before seed-2027; stop on failure, uncertainty or exhausted reservation
sequence_enforcement: operator admission gate; request dependency graph binds smoke and grid, not seed-to-seed ordering
stability_gate: compare saved selection loss and F1 for seeds 42, 7, 2027; each range must be <=0.05; never select the luckiest seed or expand search

cost.policy: operator-managed admission ledger, not provider monetary cutoff
cost.gate_before_each_create: accounted confirmation charges + outstanding confirmation commitments + next reservation <=25; refresh quotes and reject unknown/unbounded components
cost.release_policy: retain full 12.50 per submitted Job until actual charges reconcile; no savings authorize extra Jobs
cost.anomaly_policy: cancel this stage's active Job and stop sequence if runtime/spend assumptions fail; reconcile before another create
cost.after_retention_review: separate operator disposition and cost authorization required; no automatic deletion

read_only_retry_policy.mutations: no retry after ambiguous create/publication; reconcile first; no replacement Job

logging: reuse sealed grid runtime; newer live epoch logging is not deployed; derive per-run reports from verified epoch artifacts
